trigger: Run only if K014 does not produce a qualified A7 topology policy with geometric-mean speedup above 1.0
scientific_status: exploratory; no fresh 70M holdout remains after K009
provenance: 70M A7 occupancy showed h/z near-total sparsity at kappa=0.5 while a/m were materially denser; K014 suffix3-active failed the fixed A7 high-sparsity numerical gate.
kernel: unchanged K001 fused signed-exact warp compaction
timing: 16 fixed development inputs, 3 paired eager passes, 48 samples per mode
qualification: both development checkpoints must pass the unchanged 16-block gates and all 338 complete validation blocks
selection_rule: maximize geometric-mean speedup across A7 kappa=0 and kappa=0.5; within 0.005 choose fewer adapted linear modules, then lexical variant id
final_policy_rule: Compare the qualified K015 winner with the qualified K014 A7 winner on their predeclared scores and use the same 0.005/fewer-modules/lexical rule. The selected static variant is reused across kappas.
interpretation: K015 diagnoses whether moderate-sparsity a/m projections cause overhead or numerical failures. It does not modify activations and does not inspect untuned checkpoints.
